title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Trading Card Game Yugioh Continuous Destruction Punch - MFC-085
descriptionText:
Poor condition.

This Yu-Gi-Oh! Trading Card Game features the character Continuous Destruction Punch from the 1996 set. The card number is MFC-085 and it is a Non-Sport Trading Card with features from the Base Set. The manufacturer is Kazuki and the card is suitable for ages 16+. 

The autograph is not included and it is not a part of any franchise or TV show. This collectible item is perfect for fans of the Yu-Gi-Oh! franchise and collectors of Non-Sport Trading Cards.
